title: Deployed production URL, environment omitted (as in the --example) -> no exploration of production
context: Field trial 3, AgentDesk, 2026-09-28. Target https://agentdeskbot.vercel.app, the live production deployment. The agent copied the shape from `browser decide --example`, which had no environment field.
observed_failure: browser decide returned hybrid (explore production with the Playwright MCP, then script). environmentIsProduction defaulted to false, so hard rule no-exploration-on-production never fired. The same factors with the flag set returned playwright-script.
reasoning_notes: An undeclared environment must be treated as production, matching authorization/policy.json (unknown_is_treated_as: production).
Fix: browser-decision/index.mjs takes environment (default unknown, treated as production); --example now shows the field.
